$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI used by editors and YAML language servers.

max_changed_files.description: Fail when the number of changed files is greater than this value. Set to 0 or omit to disable.

max_changed_lines.description: Fail when added plus deleted lines are greater than this value. Set to 0 or omit to disable.

require_pr_title_pattern.description: Go regular expression that the pull request title must match.

required_files.description: Files that must exist in the repository.

required_changed_files.description: File paths or patterns that must each match at least one changed file.

forbidden_files.description: File paths or patterns that fail the check when changed.

warn_files.description: File paths or patterns that warn when changed without failing the check.

warn_dependency_changes.description: Warn when common dependency manifests or lockfiles change.
